website.note: Royalty aggregator; no internal clinical development

ctgov.note: All XOMA-named ctgov entries are legacy/terminated/completed; XOMA does not run trials

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: XOMA Royalty Corporation is a royalty aggregator (renamed from XOMA Corporation in July 2024). It transformed its business model in 2017 to acquire economic rights to milestones and royalties from third-party drug developers. XOMA has 14 full-time employees and conducts no internal clinical development. Its portfolio includes economic interests in 120+ third-party assets (partner-owned, excluded per workflow rule). Per the per-company workflow rule #10, this company has no active P1/P2/P3 pipeline of its own.

commercial_product.note: XOMA receives royalties on third-party commercial products including VABYSMO (Roche, retinal), OJEMDA (Day One, pediatric oncology), MIPLYFFA (Zevra, NPC), IXINITY (Medexus, Hemophilia B), DSUVIA (Talphera/Alora, pain), XACIATO (Organon, women's health), DARE to PLAY (Dare). XOMA does not market these products itself.

excluded_partner_owned.indication: BPD prevention in extremely premature infants
